title: Philips Hue (Bridge v2 — CLIP v2 API)

host.title: Bridge IP / Hostname
host.description: IP address or hostname of the Philips Hue Bridge (discoverable via mDNS _hue._tcp).

applicationKey.title: Application Key
applicationKey.description: Hue application key (username). Press the bridge link button and pair to obtain it.

whiteList.title: White List
whiteList.description: Only the devices in the list will be exposed. If empty, all devices are exposed.

blackList.title: Black List
blackList.description: The devices in the list will not be exposed.

debug.title: Enable Debug
debug.description: Enable debug mode for the plugin.

unregisterOnShutdown.title: Unregister On Shutdown
unregisterOnShutdown.description: Unregister all devices on shutdown. Only for debugging.
